publisher: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives
title_or_table: Statistics of the Presidential and Congressional Election of November 5, 2024 (published March 10, 2025), House races, with margin classes and tile squares for the district maps
table_id: Clerk of the House, election statistics 2024
observation_period: General election of November 5, 2024 (Louisiana’s open primary the same day; Maine’s ranked-choice tabulation as the Clerk prints it)
geography: The 435 House districts of the 50 states
universe_or_base: Each of the 435 House races: winner, runner-up, total votes, margin and the kind of seat
unit: votes; margin in percentage points of all votes cast for the office in the district
vintage: Compiled by the Clerk from official sources, published March 10, 2025
qualification: Margin is the winner’s votes less the runner-up’s, over all votes for the office, so it reads the same in every kind of seat; blank, void, over and under votes and continuing and exhausted ballots are not votes for a candidate, and a fusion candidate’s party lines are summed. A seat with one candidate on the ballot has no margin, even where write-ins drew votes. In one-party contests both top candidates share a party, so the margin is between two candidates of one party. Alaska’s figures are the first round and Maine’s 2nd district the final round, as the Clerk prints them; Louisiana’s House races were decided in the November 5 open primary. Classes follow the margin as printed to one decimal: 1, under 5 points; 2, 5 to under 10; 3, 10 to under 20; 4, 20 or more, and every seat unopposed on the ballot. Marks: dot, unopposed on the ballot; ring, a race decided another way (one-party contests, Alaska’s first round, Maine’s 2nd district’s final round, Louisiana’s open primaries). Squares: Oath & Action’s tile layout (census-gazetteer-2024-cd119-tile-layout).

winner_group.description: the winner's party: Republican or Democratic (Minnesota’s DFL included)

runner_up.description: candidate with the second most votes

runner_up_group.description: the runner-up's party, Republican, Democratic or other

margin_pct.description: winner less runner-up, percentage points of all votes for the office

margin_printed.description: the margin as printed, one decimal, half up

margin_class.description: 1 under 5 points, 2 under 10, 3 under 20, 4 at 20 or more and unopposed

seat_kind.description: kind of seat, in the source file's words

mark.description: dot, unopposed on the ballot; ring, decided another way; empty otherwise

printed_source_line: Source: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives, Statistics of the Presidential and Congressional Election of November 5, 2024, 435 House districts. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Margins computed by Oath & Action from the official counts.
derivation: Each race's printed margin, class (data lead's ruling (f), round 3) and mark, joined to its square in the tile layout by state and district (cartographer_round3_derive.py)
